verdict:
KILL from the buy queue. This is not a dislocation; it is the equity stub of an LBO done at the top of the panel cycle, and no price on the current cash generation clears the carry bar - including the brief's own EUR9 tripwire.

THE ARITHMETIC, AFTER BOTH BENCHES AND MY OWN RE-READ OF THE ACCOUNTS. 4,654,779 shares at 31/07/2026 (AMF L.233-8 notice) - so EUR59.6M of market value at EUR12.80, not the screen's EUR64.6M. Net debt EUR47.64M (borrowings EUR58.09M less cash EUR10.46M), which is 80% of the market cap and none of which the screen saw. True EV ~EUR107M against FY25 free cash flow of EUR4.98M (CFO EUR15.0M less capex EUR10.0M, of which EUR9.65M intangible) - 21.5x EV/FCF. Mandatory debt amortisation is EUR7.25M in the next twelve months against that EUR4.98M of FCF, so the equity accretes only by burning a EUR10.46M cash balance while organic revenue shrinks 5.3% pro forma with France at -10.5%. FY25 net income of EUR2.99M is flattered by a tax PRODUCT of EUR0.78M driven by activating Netquest's losses; pre-tax was EUR2.16M and current cash tax was EUR2.14M, i.e. essentially all of pre-tax profit. And blue's best new finding is the mechanism underneath all of it: panelist recruitment costs are capitalised as intangibles amortised over twelve months - EUR5.6M of the EUR9.6M of FY25 intangible additions - so the 21.9% headline EBITDA margin is roughly 11% on a cash basis. That is not an accounting quibble; it is why a business with 42% revenue growth produced less cash than it did debt-free in 2024 (FCF EUR8.2M -> EUR5.0M).

WHY NO PRICE GATE SURVIVES. At EUR9 the corrected EV is ~EUR89.5M, still 17.9x FCF; to reach 10x on EUR5M of FCF the whole enterprise has to be worth EUR50M, which is roughly the debt. Blue's correction of red here also matters and I sustain it: the honest answer at EUR9 is a thin positive equity value (~EUR0.5/share), not red's 'implied equity is negative' - the conclusion is unchanged but the arithmetic must be right in the file. So the disposition is not 'buy lower'; it is 'the anchor is disputed, do not arm a price on a number we do not believe' (the CAI rung logic, inverted). The only thing that reopens this name is FCF rebasing to EUR8M or better, and that is an evidence question with a date.

WHERE OUR OWN BENCHES ERRED. First, a process defect the queue should not have allowed: TWO red artifacts were filed for one case (01:06 and 01:08 on 2026-08-17) and blue adjudicated only the first. The second red's decisive claim - that the mitigant inverts because Cint's -20.5% was a stale Q3-2025 datum while Cint's Q1-2026 printed +2.6% constant currency, making Bilendi the underperformer rather than the sector victim - was therefore never tested by any bench. It is a WebSearch-sourced claim about a third-party issuer's print, it would change the class from 'cyclical trough' to 'company-specific share loss', and it goes into this verdict as PLAUSIBLE-UNAUDITED, not as a finding. Second, red's own EV double-count would have propagated straight into the reopen gate had blue not caught it - the same shape of error red was hunting. Third, on coverage: red's 'not an orphan, 3 analysts' finding is doctrinally acceptable in its narrow form, because what it actually establishes is that EuroLand's EUR26.40 target is SPONSORED research announced by the issuer's own PR, i.e. not an independent external anchor. That is an attack on the anchor's independence, not a kill on the fact of coverage, and it is the right way to use coverage information. What nobody did was the positive half of the divergence work - state what any independent forecaster models for FY26 FCF against our EUR5M - and that gap is why this file has no gradeable edge claim, only a carry rejection.

SIZE IS NOT WHY WE ARE KILLING IT (2026-08-18 rule, applied). ADV is ~5,489 shares, roughly EUR75-80k per day. At the 1%-of-ADV participation limit that is ~EUR800/day, so a 1% position in a ~$1.03M book (~$10.3k) takes about twelve trading days to build and a comparable exit. Slow and one-way, but buildable - it is a sizing and tranching constraint, not a disqualifier. The kill stands entirely on carry arithmetic; delete the liquidity argument from the record so it cannot be mistaken for the reason.

MOAT-REFUTATION CHECK (2026-08-18 rule): nothing in this record credits new entrants or capacity growth as the bear case. The panel market has four global owners and Bilendi's price/volume problem is client budget hesitation plus France-specific share loss, with the comp question unresolved. There is no 'absorbed expansion' story to mistake for damage here.
blue_ruling: SUSTAINED (finding 2 REDUCED, finding 10 arithmetic corrected) - blue read all 35 pages of the FY25 consolidated accounts and the AMF notice itself rather than relying on red's citations, sustained the leverage, cash-conversion and tax findings in full, and found the one double-count in red's own case: red added the EUR13.83M panelist-points provision to net debt as incremental debt-like claim, producing EV ~EUR121M and 24x EV/FCF. I re-fetched the FY25 comptes consolides PDF and read note 7 directly. Blue is RIGHT and the numbers are exact: the points provision moved 8,383,619 (31.12.2024) -> 13,826,058 (31.12.2025), and the bridge is dotations 6,202,727 against reprises non utilisees (6,555,930), FX (32,072) and variation de perimetre +5,827,714. Ex-perimeter the liability SHRANK ~EUR0.35M; the entire increase is the Netquest entry, and the annual redemption cost already runs through EBITDA per note 3.10. So it is a deferred-revenue-like operating liability, not incremental debt. Corrected EV ~EUR107M, EV/FCF ~21.5x. Blue's correction PASSES the re-fetch. I also re-verified, verbatim from the same PDF: borrowings 58,091,699 (maturities 7,248,948 <1yr / 28,546,924 1-5yr / 22,295,827 >5yr), the tax line as a +780,648 PRODUCT, group net income 2,991,137, CFO 14,998,601, cash movement (5,428,187), and note 21's nantissements of EUR44,000,000 Netquest titles plus EUR6,000,000 Bilendi GmbH with the key-man delegation. Red's arithmetic ties everywhere except the double-count blue caught.
reopen_gates: DATE-CERTAIN, ISSUER-PRIMARY: 2026-10-07, H1-2026 detailed results (company financial calendar - this is an issuer calendar date, not a yfinance guess). Reopen ONLY on the conjunction: 30/06/2026 net debt <= EUR45M AND H1 EBITDA margin >= 21% AND covenant terms actually disclosed with >= 30% headroom AND organic revenue >= 0%. Any single leg failing keeps the name dead. Abort-side: net debt > EUR50M or H1 EBITDA margin < 19% confirms the LBO-stub read and the name is closed for the cycle.

DATA (the real reopen, undated): FCF rebased to >= EUR8M on a full year with intangible capex below 9% of sales - i.e. the 2024 cash-generation level restored after the Netquest integration. Nothing else changes the carry bar; a revenue recovery that runs through capitalised panelist acquisition does not count.

NO PRICE GATE IS ARMED, DELIBERATELY. The brief's EUR9.0 tripwire is VOID (17.9x EV/FCF on the corrected EV) and arming any level would anchor a purchase to an FCF number this court has ruled disputed. If a level is wanted for monitoring only, it is ~EUR6 - and even there it works only if FCF is already demonstrably >= EUR8M, which makes the FCF gate the binding one and the price incidental.

AUDIT (owed, cheap): verify the second red bench's Cint claim at the primary - Cint Group Q1-2026 report, constant-currency revenue growth and vintage. If Cint really has returned to growth while Bilendi runs -5% cc, the class flips from sector cycle to company-specific share loss and even the 2026-10-07 conjunction should be tightened. This is currently the only untested decisive claim in the file.

EVENT: any refinancing, covenant waiver, equity raise or acquisition announcement. With Netquest and Bilendi GmbH shares both pledged and a EUR4M key-man delegation on the 15.1% founder, a financing event is the moment the undisclosed covenant package becomes visible - and it is also the moment the reaffirmed EUR175-200M-by-2030 target (roughly 2x revenue from a shrinking base) has to be paid for.
process_findings: HELD STATUS: NOT HELD, and no ledger row exists for ALBLD.PA. This draft creates one at AVOID with a single dated reopen (2026-10-07) and NO armed price gate - deliberately, because arming a price would anchor a buy to an FCF number the court ruled disputed.

BLUE-CORRECTIONS-AUDITED: blue's EV/points-provision correction was re-fetched at the primary (FY25 comptes consolides, note 7) and PASSES exactly - dotations 6,202,727 vs reprises 6,555,930 with the entire increase from the Netquest perimeter. Red's EUR121M/24x was the artifact; EUR107M/21.5x stands. Blue's correction of red's 'implied equity negative' at EUR9 also passes (thin positive ~EUR0.5/share); conclusion unchanged.

PROCESS DEFECT (validator-grade): TWO COURT_RED artifacts were filed for this case (2026-08-17 01:06 and 01:08) and the blue bench adjudicated only the first. The second red's Cint-comp inversion - which would reclassify the whole thesis from cyclical to share-loss - has never been tested by any bench and enters the record as PLAUSIBLE-UNAUDITED. Mirror image of the BMM twin-blue defect; see the duplicate_bench_contradiction_unreconciled candidate filed under BMM.

DIVERGENCE-NOT-COVERAGE: no coverage-count kill was made. Red's sponsored-research finding is the permitted form (it attacks anchor independence, not the existence of coverage) and I sustain it. What is missing is the positive half - no independent forecast for FY26 FCF was ever obtained, so this file rejects on absolute carry rather than on a stated divergence, which is honest but ungradeable as edge.

SIZE TEST (2026-08-18 rule): ADV ~5,489 shares ~ EUR75-80k/day; at 1% of ADV a 1% position in a ~$1.03M book takes ~12 trading days to build. Slow, one-way, but NOT a disqualifier - the kill is carry arithmetic. Strike 'un-ownable on liquidity' from the record.

SCREEN DEFECTS (both real, both upstream): share-count join error (screen implied 5.049M shares vs the AMF notice's 4,654,779, +8.5% on market cap) and mcap-only screening on a name whose net debt is 80% of market cap. Also the screen row's mcap_resolved_ccy 'EUR@1.09' is a unit hazard - the value is already EUR, so any downstream FX divide double-counts (priceMagnifier lesson).

TAX: no dividend, so no distribution carry to adjust; French statutory withholding is moot. PEA-PME eligibility is irrelevant to a US taxable holder. All return would be capital gain, and at ~12 days to build/exit the position would be structurally short-term for a long stretch.
PRINT CLOCK: 2026-10-07 is ~36 trading days from 2026-08-17/18 - well outside the 5-day print-race window, so no pre-print reconstruction was owed and none was skipped.

FILER QUALITY, STATED FOR BALANCE: French GAAP (ANC 2024-05), no IFRS-16 EBITDA inflation, and every figure both benches and I checked ties to the cent. This is a well-disclosed company with a bad capital structure - the kill is not an integrity kill.

kg_candidates.name: loyalty_points_provision_debtlike
kg_candidates.source: red bench (ALBLD.PA); blue corrected the trigger; adjudicator re-fetched note 7 and confirms the correction
kg_candidates.disposition: ACCEPT AS AMENDED - harvest with blue's guard, renamed to fire on 'provision growing faster than its own P&L charge'. The raw form (points provisions are hidden debt) would have produced a false 24x here: my re-read shows dotations 6,202,727 vs reprises 6,555,930, so ex-perimeter the liability shrank and the annual cost is already inside EBITDA. The debt-like reading is valid only when the stock grows faster than the charge that funds it.
kg_candidates.one_line: Unredeemed loyalty/panelist points provisions are debt-like only when the provision stock grows faster than the annual P&L charge that services it; a stock that grows purely by acquisition perimeter, with reprises >= dotations, is a deferred-revenue-like operating liability and must not be added to net debt.
kg_candidates.fires_on: panel/loyalty/rewards operators whose provisions line grows materially year over year - then decompose the movement table into dotations, reprises, FX and variation de perimetre before treating any of it as debt
kg_candidates.evidence_here: ALBLD note 7: points provision 8,383,619 -> 13,826,058; dotations 6,202,727, reprises non utilisees (6,555,930), FX (32,072), perimetre +5,827,714 (the Netquest entry, disclosed as such). Red added the full stock to net debt (EV EUR121M, 24x); the corrected EV is EUR107M, 21.5x.

kg_candidates.name: capitalized_panelist_acquisition_ebitda_mask
kg_candidates.source: blue bench (ALBLD.PA) - new finding red missed
kg_candidates.disposition: ACCEPT - the single most valuable output of this court. It converts a 21.9% headline EBITDA margin into ~11% on cash and explains the FCF collapse that the leverage findings only described.
kg_candidates.one_line: Recurring short-life member/panelist acquisition costs capitalised as intangibles and amortised over <= 12 months route operating spend around EBITDA; EBITDA-minus-capex is the only honest margin for these operators.
kg_candidates.fires_on: panel/marketplace/loyalty operators whose 'autres immobilisations incorporelles' additions approach or exceed development capex, with sub-one-year amortisation disclosed in the accounting-policies note
kg_candidates.evidence_here: ALBLD p.20: panel-member acquisition costs amortised over 12 months; EUR5.6M of EUR9.6M FY25 intangible additions - cash EBITDA margin ~11% vs the 21.9% headline, and intangible capex up 68% year over year.

kg_candidates.name: sponsored_only_coverage_false_anchor
kg_candidates.disposition: ACCEPT - and note explicitly in the KG entry that this is the DOCTRINALLY CLEAN use of coverage information under DIVERGENCE-NOT-COVERAGE. It does not say 'covered therefore priced'; it says the only published target is issuer-paid and therefore is not an external anchor, which is a statement about anchor independence. Pair it with the requirement that the bench then go find an independent number or declare none exists.
kg_candidates.one_line: When the sole analyst coverage is issuer-paid sponsored research whose initiation was announced by the issuer's own PR, both 'covered implies priced' and the target price are invalid anchors - the name is anchor-less, not anchored.
kg_candidates.fires_on: small caps citing analyst targets where the research provider self-describes as sponsored/commissioned or the initiation is announced through the issuer's own newswire
kg_candidates.evidence_here: ALBLD: Bilendi's own PR announced EuroLand Corporate's EUR26.40 initiation at EUR16.5; EuroLand markets 'sponsored financial analysis'. The stock is -22% since. The brief's 'not an orphan, 3 analysts' leg rested on it, and only one of the three was ever audited.

kg_candidates.name: stale_comp_vintage_inversion
kg_candidates.source: red bench #2 (ALBLD.PA 202608170108) - the red artifact no blue bench adjudicated
kg_candidates.disposition: ACCEPT PENDING VERIFICATION - the rule is good and general (any 'milder than the comp' mitigant must carry the comp's vintage), but its evidence row rests on an unaudited WebSearch read of Cint's Q1-2026. Verify at Cint's own report before the row is graded, and mark the candidate provisional in the KG until then.

kg_candidates.evidence_here: ALBLD: the brief's comp anchor was Cint at -20.5% (Q3-2025, vintage flagged UNVERIFIED by the triage itself); red #2 reports Cint Q1-2026 at +2.6% constant currency against Bilendi's -5.0% cc, which would make Bilendi the share loser rather than the cycle victim.

packs_to_arm.date_confidence: ISSUER CALENDAR (company financial calendar, cited by the triage and both benches) - NOT yfinance-derived. Confirm once against the Bilendi IR calendar page when the pack is armed; the pack's own NEXT PRINT field was null.
packs_to_arm.adjudication: This print is the whole trade and it is the first venue where the missing numbers can appear. Read in order: (1) 30/06/2026 net debt against EUR47.64M and against the EUR45M reopen bar - remember mandatory amortisation of EUR7.25M/yr, so flat net debt means the cash balance funded it; (2) covenant terms - existence is confirmed (the auditor bills for 'certifications liees aux covenants bancaires') but no ratio has ever been published; a first disclosure with headroom is the single most informative datum; (3) H1 EBITDA margin against 21.9% and, more importantly, EBITDA minus intangible capex - the cash margin, since panel-recruitment capitalisation is the mechanism; (4) organic growth and France specifically against -10.5%; (5) any commentary on the EUR175-200M 2030 target, which requires roughly a doubling and therefore serial M&A off pledged collateral.

branches.NET DEBT <= EUR45M AND COVENANTS DISCLOS: the conjunction the kill was conditioned on; reopen a fresh court (not this one) and re-derive the carry bar on the new FCF path - fresh benches, since this adjudicator is now conflicted.
branches.NET DEBT EUR45-50M, COVENANTS DISCLOSED,: the stub is stable but the carry bar is unchanged at ~20x; stay dead, re-arm for the 2027-02-24 FY26 revenue print.
branches.NET DEBT > EUR50M OR EBITDA MARGIN < 19%: confirms the LBO-stub read; close the name for the cycle and stop spending tokens on it.
branches.EQUITY RAISE OR COVENANT WAIVER ANNOUNCE: the undisclosed package becomes visible under duress; re-court only as a distressed-structure question, not as a value question.
